content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"review","note":"The record links the relocation denial to seven essential functions that could not be performed from Florida, but the summary itself says the position description was unchanged and Complainant had performed those functions from Florida, and no undue hardship analysis or productivity data connects evidence to the Claim 2 ratings or the FAD's conclusion."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Many characterizations are attributed to named officials (RMO1's low productivity claim, RMO4/RMO5's seven functions, the FOHS doctor), but RMO2 testified to hearsay, RMO6 was not interviewed by the investigator, the FY 2015 evaluation is missing, and RMO1's productivity assertions have no cited metrics."},"rc3":{"status":"pass","note":"Dated events are largely in order (relocation order 9/27/2016, requests and denials 1/2017 to 8/16/2017, FOHS 4/17-18/2017, evaluations FY2013-FY2017, FAD request 2/23/2018), though the PIP dates and the telework history are unclear."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not show who made the final decision or on what criteria: RMO4 declined to delineate an undue hardship analysis, the 'individual assessment' is only possibly the FOHS review, management never responded to Complainant's alternative-position suggestions, and the FAD itself is stated only as a bare conclusion with no reasoning."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"The record cannot stand alone because the FAD conclusion has no stated rationale, key evidence is missing or ambiguous (FY2015 evaluation, PIP details, meaning of 'headquarters', undue hardship factors), and RC4 is not met."}}}
